skill.name: clinicaltrials-database
skill.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 for studies by condition, intervention, location, sponsor, status, or NCT ID. Retrieve trial details and export results for research review.
skill.summary: Find and summarize clinical trial records from ClinicalTrials.gov API v2.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, public ClinicalTrials.gov API usage, and fixed-name CSV export examples. No prompt injection, secret access, data exfiltration, arbitrary shell execution, or local system reconnaissance was found.

remediation.issue: Helper script requests do not set explicit timeouts.
remediation.suggestion: Add a timeout value to each requests.get call to avoid long-running network waits.
State that trial data summaries are not medical advice and must be confirmed against source records.

remediation.issue: Network scope is documented but not emphasized.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that the skill contacts only ClinicalTrials.gov and does not require credentials.

content.value_statement: Clinical trial searches can be slow when filters and registry fields are unfamiliar. This skill guides public registry queries, study lookups, and CSV exports.
actual_capabilities: Search studies by condition, intervention, location, sponsor, status, and NCT ID.
Retrieve detailed ClinicalTrials.gov study records by NCT ID.
Paginate through large result sets with the included helper script.
Extract summaries with title, status, phase, enrollment, summary, and last update.
Export API results in JSON or CSV formats for analysis.
Reference API parameters, status values, error handling, and rate limits.
limitations: Uses public ClinicalTrials.gov data and may reflect registry update delays.
Does not verify eligibility, enrollment availability, or medical suitability.
Requires internet access for live API queries.
Bulk retrieval must respect ClinicalTrials.gov API rate limits.

use_cases.title: Find Recruiting Trials
use_cases.description: Search active studies for a condition, intervention, and location before reviewing eligibility details.

use_cases.title: Review Study Details
use_cases.description: Look up an NCT ID and summarize status, criteria, contacts, locations, and last update date.

use_cases.title: Build Trial Datasets
use_cases.description: Export filtered trial results for spreadsheet analysis, dashboards, or research portfolio review.

prompt_templates.title: Search Recruiting Studies
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search by condition and status.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for recruiting breast cancer trials. Return NCT ID, title, phase, status, and last update date.

prompt_templates.title: Find Local Trial Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Filter by condition, location, and recruitment status.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find recruiting diabetes trials near Boston, Massachusetts. Include study locations, contacts when available, and eligibility highlights.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Intervention Trials
prompt_templates.scenario: Research a specific intervention across studies.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for Phase 3 trials testing Pembrolizumab. Summarize sponsor, condition, status, enrollment, and whether results are posted.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Bulk Export
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for larger result sets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a ClinicalTrials.gov API query plan for all recruiting rare disease trials. Include pagination, rate limits, CSV export, and fields to validate.

output_examples.input: Search for recruiting lung cancer trials in California.
output: Returns matching studies with NCT ID, title, phase, recruitment status, and California site details.
Highlights records that need source confirmation before patient outreach.

output_examples.output: Returns the study title, status, summary, eligibility overview, contacts, locations, and last update date from the API record.

output_examples.input: Export Alzheimer's disease trials for analysis.
output_examples.output: Prepares a CSV-oriented query plan with page size, status filters, rate-limit handling, and fields to review after export.

best_practices: Confirm important trial details on the source record before clinical use.
Use specific filters to reduce irrelevant results and API requests.
Add pagination and retry handling for large searches.
anti_patterns: Do not treat registry data as medical advice or eligibility confirmation.
Do not scrape large result sets without respecting rate limits.
Do not assume every trial record has contacts, results, or complete locations.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: No. ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 is public and does not require authentication.

faq.question: Can it find trials by NCT ID?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve detailed study records when you provide an NCT identifier.

faq.question: Can it export results?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports JSON responses and CSV-oriented exports for analysis workflows.

faq.question: Can it confirm patient eligibility?
faq.answer: No. It can summarize listed criteria, but eligibility must be confirmed by qualified study staff.

faq.question: Does it include trial results?
faq.answer: It can identify and retrieve posted results when they are available in the ClinicalTrials.gov record.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
